name: notifications-campaigns
title: Notification Campaigns
description: Compatibility export of @krak-stack/notifications-admin/campaigns for host-protected campaign administration. Import its Tailwind stylesheet and share the registry KrakstackProvider. Hosts own authorization and localized messages.
docs: Mount NotificationCampaigns behind the host admin guard. Supply authorized page/detail/report data from @krak-stack/notifications/admin, localized messages, and API-backed callbacks. Pass controlled KrakStack table state and server pagination with the authoritative rowCount. Scheduling snapshots subscribed contacts; completion means fan-out finished, not confirmed delivery. Host authorization, sender safeguards and durable workflows remain required. Package export: @krak-stack/registry/notifications/campaigns.
